name: Software and Technology
description: Covers software development, data engineering, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure roles across Nigerian tech companies and startups.

sub_roles.name: Frontend Developer
sub_roles.description: Builds user interfaces and web experiences using modern JavaScript frameworks.

sub_roles.name: Backend Developer
sub_roles.description: Designs and builds server-side logic, APIs, and database integrations.

sub_roles.name: Mobile Developer
sub_roles.description: Creates cross-platform or native mobile applications for Android and iOS.

sub_roles.name: Data Analyst
sub_roles.description: Analyses datasets to extract insights and support business decision-making.

sub_roles.name: Cybersecurity Analyst
sub_roles.description: Identifies vulnerabilities and implements controls to protect digital systems.

sub_roles.name: UI/UX Designer
sub_roles.description: Designs intuitive user interfaces and end-to-end user experiences for digital products.

sub_roles.name: DevOps Engineer
sub_roles.description: Manages CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and cloud deployments.

name: Engineering and Manufacturing
description: Covers mechanical, electrical, civil, and production engineering roles in Nigerian industrial and construction sectors.

sub_roles.name: Mechanical Engineer (Intern)
sub_roles.description: Assists in design, analysis, and maintenance of mechanical systems and equipment.

sub_roles.name: Electrical / Electronics Engineer (Intern)
sub_roles.description: Works on electrical installations, circuit design, and electronic systems.

sub_roles.name: Civil Engineer (Intern)
sub_roles.description: Supports site supervision, structural analysis, and construction project management.

sub_roles.name: Production / Manufacturing Engineer (Intern)
sub_roles.description: Supports production planning, quality control, and lean manufacturing practices.

sub_roles.name: Petroleum / Chemical Engineer (Intern)
sub_roles.description: Assists in process engineering, refinery operations, and petrochemical production.

sub_roles.name: Quality Assurance Engineer (Intern)
sub_roles.description: Ensures products and processes meet defined standards and specifications.

name: Business and Management
description: Covers business administration, project management, strategy, and operations roles.

sub_roles.name: Business Analyst
sub_roles.description: Bridges business needs with technical solutions through data analysis and process improvement.

sub_roles.name: Project Management Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports planning, execution, and monitoring of projects across teams.

sub_roles.name: Operations Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in optimising day-to-day business operations and supply chain activities.

sub_roles.name: Human Resources Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports recruitment, onboarding, and HR administration activities.

sub_roles.name: Strategy & Consulting Intern
sub_roles.description: Contributes to strategy development, market analysis, and client presentations.

sub_roles.name: Entrepreneurship / Startup Intern
sub_roles.description: Works within an early-stage company across multiple business functions.

name: Finance and Accounting
description: Covers financial analysis, accounting, auditing, and investment roles in Nigerian banks, firms, and corporations.

sub_roles.name: Accounting Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in bookkeeping, financial statement preparation, and account reconciliation.

sub_roles.name: Financial Analyst Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports financial modelling, forecasting, and investment analysis.

sub_roles.name: Audit & Assurance Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in internal and external audit procedures and compliance reviews.

sub_roles.name: Banking Operations Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports daily banking operations, customer service, and transaction processing.

sub_roles.name: Tax Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in tax computation, returns filing, and regulatory compliance.

name: Health and Life Sciences
description: Covers clinical, pharmaceutical, public health, and biomedical roles in Nigerian hospitals, labs, and health agencies.

sub_roles.name: Clinical / Medical Intern
sub_roles.description: Rotates through hospital departments providing supervised patient care support.

sub_roles.name: Pharmacy Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in dispensing, drug counselling, and pharmaceutical operations.

sub_roles.name: Public Health Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports health promotion, disease surveillance, and community health programmes.

sub_roles.name: Biomedical Science / Lab Intern
sub_roles.description: Performs laboratory analyses and assists in diagnostic and research procedures.

sub_roles.name: Nursing / Midwifery Intern
sub_roles.description: Provides supervised nursing care across clinical wards and community settings.

name: Media and Communications
description: Covers journalism, broadcasting, digital marketing, public relations, and creative content roles.

sub_roles.name: Digital Marketing Intern
sub_roles.description: Manages social media, content strategy, SEO, and online advertising campaigns.

sub_roles.name: Journalism / Content Intern
sub_roles.description: Researches, writes, and edits news stories, articles, and multimedia content.

sub_roles.name: Public Relations Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports brand reputation management, media relations, and press communications.

sub_roles.name: Graphic Design Intern
sub_roles.description: Creates visual assets for digital and print media across marketing and branding projects.

sub_roles.name: Video Production Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in filming, editing, and post-production of video content.

name: Education and Social Services
description: Covers teaching, social work, community development, and NGO programme delivery roles.

sub_roles.name: Teaching / Instruction Intern
sub_roles.description: Delivers supervised classroom instruction and supports curriculum development.

sub_roles.name: Social Work Intern
sub_roles.description: Provides case management, counselling support, and community outreach services.

sub_roles.name: NGO / Development Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports programme implementation, monitoring, and stakeholder engagement in development projects.

sub_roles.name: Counselling / Psychology Intern
sub_roles.description: Provides supervised counselling and psychological assessment support.

name: Architecture and Built Environment
description: Covers architecture, urban planning, quantity surveying, and estate management roles.

sub_roles.name: Architecture Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in architectural design, drafting, and project documentation under a registered architect.

sub_roles.name: Quantity Surveying Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports cost estimation, bill of quantities preparation, and contract administration.

sub_roles.name: Urban & Regional Planning Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in land use planning, GIS mapping, and community engagement for development projects.

sub_roles.name: Estate Management Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports property valuation, facility management, and real estate transactions.

name: Science and Research
description: Covers laboratory science, environmental science, mathematics, and research roles in Nigerian academic and industrial settings.

sub_roles.name: Research Assistant
sub_roles.description: Supports academic or industrial research through data collection, analysis, and literature review.

sub_roles.name: Environmental Science Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in environmental monitoring, impact assessment, and field surveys.

sub_roles.name: Laboratory Science Intern
sub_roles.description: Conducts experiments, analyses samples, and maintains laboratory records in a research or industrial lab.

sub_roles.name: Mathematics / Statistics Intern
sub_roles.description: Applies mathematical and statistical methods to analyse data and solve quantitative problems.

name: Legal and Compliance
description: Covers legal practice, compliance, policy analysis, and regulatory roles in Nigerian law firms, banks, and public sector organisations.

sub_roles.name: Legal Research Intern
sub_roles.description: Researches case law, statutes, and legal opinions to support solicitors and barristers.

sub_roles.name: Corporate Law Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in contract drafting, corporate governance, and transactional legal support.

sub_roles.name: Compliance Intern
sub_roles.description: Supports regulatory compliance, AML/KYC processes, and policy implementation.

sub_roles.name: Litigation Support Intern
sub_roles.description: Assists in court filings, case preparation, and legal documentation for active litigation matters.
